mentions.name: Exoplanet search with fable
mentions.description: This project uses the fable tool to find an exoplanet, processing data with several terabytes of server storage and a powerful GPU. The author is new to the subject and is experimenting to see what they can accomplish.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm using fable to find an exoplanet. Know nothing about it but have several TBs available in my server for data and a powerful GPU for processing so let's see what I can do with it.
mentions.author: backtr4ck
